league: Watson Family Fantasy Rugby — Nations Championship 2026 (November)

rules.fantasy_team: Each round pick a full 15, one player per starting position, plus one Supersub (a bench starter, points x3; x0.5 if he starts). Max 3 per nation across all 16 picks. Captain points double.
rules.changes: Swap any player until his match kicks off.

prediction_bonus.pick: winner (or Draw) + winning margin for every match
prediction_bonus.note: Bonus on top of fantasy player points

rules.deadline: Round entries before the round's first kick-off; individual players lock at their own match's kick-off.
rules.tiebreak: Most fantasy-player points, then most correct winners.
rules.finals: Finals Weekend round opens once match-ups are known after 21 Nov.
rules.slot_note: Props fit 1 or 3; locks 4-5; back row 6-8; centres 12-13; back three 11, 14, 15. 'Position TBC' players (FX/BX) fit any forward/back slot.

supersub.pick: One extra player who starts the match on the bench

rules.scoring_note: We only score stats that are published for every player after each match.

rounds.name: Finals Weekend
rounds.note: Match-ups set by final pool positions after 21 Nov
